notes.title: Free DLC: Trial of Antiquity
notes.content:
The first story DLC for Wild Unknown is now available and is included when you download the base game. If you already own Wild Unknown, the game will update as soon as you login to Steam.

The DLC: Trial of Antiquity features a completely new environment full of brain-teasing puzzles and expands on the story of Wild Unknown with some surprising revelations. The new content can be accessed from the pause menu, or by finding one of the hidden endings in the original game.

The update also optimizes indoor lighting for improved performance of the base game. 

Thanks again for playing, and I hope you enjoy the new content!
